caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic tool positioned diagonally across a plain, light beige background. The tool has two long, straight handles that taper slightly and extend outward from a central pivot point. One end of the tool features two rounded, cup-like extensions facing opposite directions; these are attached to the broader head, which is slightly curved and thicker than the handles. The metal surface of the tool is depicted in shades of dark grey and brown, resembling aged or tarnished steel. The background is plain with no additional objects or decorations, and the name "William Frank" is faintly inscribed in the lower right corner.
title: Bullet Mold
